label: CCR2004-16G-2S+
description: MikroTik CCR2004-16G-2S+ - cloud core router: 16x 1G RJ45 and 2x 10G SFP+ cages, quad-core ARM AL32400.
notes: MikroTik specification table: section Ethernet prints "10/100/1000 Ethernet ports: 16", section Fiber prints "SFP+ ports: 2", section Peripherals prints "Serial console port: RJ45" and "Number of USB ports: 1". The manual repeats it as "Number of 1G Ethernet ports 16" and "Number of 10G SFP+ ports 2", and the product page tags the cages "SFP/SFP+", which is why the two cages keep speedCaps 1000/10000. The page has no PoE section in either direction: no port sources power and none is powered. The sixteen copper ports are 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 sockets, which the template now declares instead of leaving the connector to be inferred from the port name. Sources: https://mikrotik.com/product/ccr2004_16g_2splus and https://manual.mikrotik.com/hardware/ccr2004-16g-2s-plus/
